bio.text: Josue Ortega represents the 3rd District in the Delaware House of Representatives.
Ortega is a Wilmington native who worked for over ten years for the City of Wilmington and New Castle County, with a focus on housing services and community involvement.
Ortega lives on the north side of Hedgeville with his wife and four children.
